sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Stupid alarm, why did you die today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and panicked about being late, with a burst of irritated self-directed frustration at the alarm and a strong anxious urgency to fix the situation.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Mom's going to say it was fate punishing me for scrolling at midnight...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and self-mocking, half-panicked about being late but trying to lighten the moment with a joking, resigned complaint about her mom’s inevitable teasing.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Wait, seriously? They never open this gate.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly shifting from panicked frustration to startled, hopeful curiosity, sensing an unexpected lucky break and mentally grabbing onto it.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Yeah, that was the problem, thanks.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and irritated at being reminded of the obvious, but her urgency keeps it sharp and brisk rather than truly hostile.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels wary and puzzled, with her earlier rush giving way to cautious suspicion at the stranger’s oddly precise warning.
sprite_sequence.label: confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled and suspicious, with a flicker of self-conscious embarrassment as the stranger’s uncanny familiarity makes her defensive.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: How do you know that before the board goes up?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and uneasy, with her usual boldness turning into sharp suspicion as she tries to make sense of the girl’s impossible knowledge.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. Creepy. Helpful, maybe, but creepy.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and uneasy, but trying to keep her composure with nervous humor while also feeling a flicker of curiosity and gratitude toward the girl’s oddly helpful warning.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Yes! I might actually make it!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sudden surge of relieved, energized optimism, with her earlier panic easing into excited determination as she realizes she may still salvage the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into stunned, uneasy disbelief as the eerie warning suddenly proves real, with a flash of fear under her usual lively confidence.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: She said not to use the east stairs.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp, uneasy jolt of fear and vindicated alarm, realizing the stranger’s eerie warning may have just saved her from something serious.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, come on. Don't do this to me on day one.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of alarm and frustrated disbelief, with a growing sense that something uncanny is targeting her and that she needs to stay alert.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Fine. School first. Panic attack later.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, joking composure while underneath she feels shaken, suspicious, and newly frightened by how narrowly she seems to have avoided disaster.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious
